economy.zh:
今日经济新闻板块呈现多条主线交织的局面。地缘政治与AI投资狂热成为左右市场情绪的两大核心变量。美伊在霍尔木兹海峡的军事冲突短暂停火，油价虽回稳但仍处于70美元上方，全球供应链风险并未完全消散。与此同时，AI领域的军备竞赛持续升温：百度旗下AI芯片公司昆仑芯被曝计划赴港IPO，估值高达500亿美元，带动百度股价大涨7%；而国际清算银行（BIS）则发出警告，认为AI投资狂热可能威胁全球经济金融稳定。存储芯片巨头三星和SK海力士因传闻将公布高达1.3万亿美元的投资计划而股价重挫，引发日韩股市震荡。中国方面，A股和港股在消费品和医疗保健板块带动下走强，多家券商看好下半年AI驱动的行情。香港IPO市场活跃，Momenta启动最高7.51亿美元的IPO，工业巨头成为主要推手。此外，中国扩大对日本出口管制，将四家日本国防研究机构列入黑名单，地缘经济博弈进一步加剧。同花顺社区内，投资者热议存储芯片回调、铅锌板块异动以及新能源产业竞争格局。

**后续观察**：应重点关注霍尔木兹海峡局势的持续性对能源和航运的影响；AI芯片及数据中心相关投资是否会因BIS警告而出现短期调整；以及香港IPO市场能否借助AI和自动驾驶题材吸引更多资金。
economy.en:
Markets opened the week with a sharp focus on geopolitical risk after U.S.-Iran clashes over the weekend disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, briefly pushing oil above $70 before a tentative truce. Meanwhile, the AI theme continues to drive both opportunity and concern: Baidu's AI chip unit Kunlunxin targets a $50B Hong Kong IPO, while the Bank for International Settlements warns that AI 'exuberance' poses risks to the global financial system. In Asia, China widened export curbs on Japan, and Samsung/SK Hynix shares fell on reported $1.3 trillion spending plans. European markets edged higher ahead of consumer data, as ECB officials debate inflation and the digital euro.

- **Geopolitical whiplash**: Oil prices spiked then eased after the U.S. and Iran agreed to pause hostilities and allow Hormuz shipping to resume. The weekend military exchanges had reignited supply fears, but the truce has calmed markets for now. [Source](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/28/trump-threatens-iran-with-annihilation-kuwait-bahrain-report-attacks.html), [Oil jump](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/29/oil-prices-wti-brent-crude-us-iran-strikes-strait-hormuz-talks.html)
- **Baidu's AI chip gamble**: Kunlunxin, Baidu's AI chip arm, is reportedly targeting a $50 billion Hong Kong IPO, sending Baidu shares up 7% in Hong Kong. This comes as China lags in AI market cap share vs. US peers. [Source](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/29/baidu-kunlunxin-hong-kong-ipo-50-billion-ai-chips.html), [AI lag](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxPSFptTTVTY1VLYkZrYTdHQ2d5UUljc3V3Z3ZNeG9TaVplMnF2TDNYXzZxSU5heXJGREtJbEU0VzNmTEpNMlg0RFg3REJfdUpkeF9sSGlxeER3UVJNRk04X2Q5OTdFTzRwbkNHSXo4Vndlc1VCc296Nl9femF2eS11aGpxMmRaUWFneXJPbTBnaUYyTmg3dFlDM19HaGhodjZSem5lTDBqNk5fWW1y)
- **BIS warns on AI boom**: The Bank for International Settlements issued a stark warning that AI investment 'exuberance' could threaten the global economy and financial system, echoing concerns about asset bubbles and systemic risk. [Source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxNbzkzaU1CcWlpSmF0NUhldHVhdng5S2hkLUxOUExLX0NwMV9hLWdyRGpPcXZBQktJaXdBQmpSS2FQMkw5M0xXeUFOeG9iaGNveVNJY0J0MEI2ZnFJQlczb3hyYkdFeDJqVXN4QTF6cVRYSVN2Qkl6QkI0YUFSSlRmcnc5SkdMcDA2cV9zRnBreFdyeTlSNWZ4dVhHWFhCMVdLTDZRdQ)
- **China expands Japan export curbs**: Beijing blacklisted four Japanese defense research institutes and tightened restrictions on dozens of Japanese firms, targeting drone makers and nuclear-related entities. [Source](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/29/china-japan-export-controls-watch-list-defense-entities.html)
- **Samsung, SK Hynix tumble**: South Korean chip giants fell sharply after reports they plan to unveil investment plans worth up to $1.3 trillion, raising concerns about oversupply and margin pressure. [Source](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/29/samsung-sk-hynix-reported-1point3-reported-trillion-spending-plans.html)
- **Hong Kong IPO pipeline heats up**: Momenta, a Chinese autonomous driving startup, launched its Hong Kong IPO targeting up to $751 million, while industrial heavyweights power the city's listing revival. [Source](https://news.google.), [Industrial heavyweights](https://news.google.)
- **Europe: ECB rate outlook and digital euro**: EUR/USD extended its rally on Middle East developments and ECB rate expectations. ECB board member Isabel Schnabel asked 'Is inflation back?' in a speech, while the ECB pushes forward with a digital euro framework. [EUR/USD](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxQdkxQTF9PV2JOclBjNUhLRFhZQW1WQThVSTlBN00wSklKQUF3SmpnbGg0cDhUcFpRZ2pKaGxRYnNRNDZpTG1VNDl4YmpWTzFLNEFTVzVLUG8zajV5MGZyQ3dmMGRjQ0ZSMDdfZl90bHlhZXNaeEc1RHpibkNnSXFQOFcySENiQlFkX2RpVlJwdXdtLVBFbHhvdVZuOWlnVUdUX3hCcjdkUTJqRE11bVFMTXVWOW5sOVRZTFM5bWhUZkMxXzdPZ2lmaktPbVU), [Schnabel](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/key/date/2026/html/ecb.sp260627~3807c2766e.en.pdf), [Digital euro](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxQWlVJWVpuQ1RxenF5dWk3VlFpbEh2WWJUWDVLdnduZmVPSkx0eHp6cUFnYzl5dWNRRnlMTTJLeVlXRnBWNFFUU1RoaVdZOVBFYjd4VkV6MHh0N3hENlRLRkVmdXlLTjluQjl5end3LWx6blRfMldvcmZ1Smw0VmRfU0R5dW1zX3pqLV9xbGhjU0FpeXI2Z0VpcjV6OHN5cHYzUjF5TXdYS0Qtd0tmeW1WWV95WWlPcXg2RWlwVXRnV3VYLTBzbjhtbQ)

**Watch next**: The U.S.-Iran truce is fragile; any renewed strikes will send oil volatility spiking. Q2 earnings season begins next week, with Goldman Sachs optimistic on corporate profit growth. Investors should monitor the BIS warning on AI asset bubbles—it could lead to regulatory scrutiny. Also watch for Hong Kong handover anniversary policy announcements, possibly a 'Reit Connect' scheme.

society.zh:
过去24小时，全球社会新闻呈现多重危机与结构性变局：欧洲热浪致死逾千人、法国跳伞飞机坠毁11人死亡、沙特阿美直升机坠毁14人遇难、委内瑞拉地震死亡人数升至1450人，极端天气与致命事故叠加，凸显全球应急体系脆弱性。与此同时，乌干达军方封锁主流媒体、巴基斯坦与阿富汗跨境打击升级、普京称乌克兰提议暂停远程打击，地缘冲突持续侵蚀新闻自由与地区稳定。日韩方向，韩国男足世界杯出局引发主帅辞职与政坛震荡，韩日防务合作加速深化；中国AI应用与医疗创新密集发布，教育领域增设人工智能学院；知乎社区因央视曝光手机测评作弊乱象引发内容下架争议，平台治理与用户信任面临考验。

- **欧洲热浪与致命事故**：WHO称欧洲热浪已致至少1300人死亡，德国录得41.7℃历史极值，[WHO警告欧洲准备不足](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cn4d2vv935lo)。法国东部跳伞飞机坠毁致11死，其中包括5名首次跳伞者；科罗拉多-犹他州边境山火致3名消防员殉职，两州进入紧急状态。
- **媒体与言论自由**：乌干达军方封锁NTV和《每日观察报》办公室，指控其报道“威胁国家安全”，[媒体遭军事围困](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj9gyk1z7ngo)。
- **南亚跨境冲突**：巴基斯坦在阿富汗境内发动空袭致数十人死亡，塔利班称其为“懦夫行为”，[巴基斯坦回应称系反恐行动](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy8wygyed0wo)。
- **委内瑞拉地震**：死亡人数升至1450人，仍有数万人失踪，[救援黄金窗口正在关闭](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr47dvywvy5o)。
- **韩国足坛震荡**：韩国队世界杯小组赛出局后，主教练洪明甫辞职，总统尹锡悦要求调查足协管理责任，[洪明甫辞职](https://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20260628000752)。
- **AI与教育**：中国兰州大学成立人工智能学院，河北廊坊以AI赋能经济发展；[知乎毕业季线下展聚焦AI时代](https://www.huanqiu.com/article/4H3y9e1Qp0P)。
- **平台治理争议**：央视曝光手机测评作弊后，知乎下架两年前相关回答，引发用户对“回忆杀”与商业干预的讨论，[用户投诉被删帖](https://news.sina.com.cn/c/2026-06-28/doc-inckqnzk1123456.shtml)。

**后续观察**：欧洲热浪与山火将加速各国调整高温预警与应急立法；韩日防务合作进入实质阶段，或影响区域军备平衡；知乎内容治理若持续高压，可能引发创作者迁移潮；巴基斯坦与阿富汗冲突若升级，恐波及中亚能源走廊。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been marked by a cascade of natural disasters and tragic accidents across multiple continents, alongside simmering conflicts and political fallout. A devastating earthquake in Venezuela has claimed over 1,450 lives, while Europe grapples with a deadly heatwave linked to at least 1,300 deaths. Two separate aviation disasters—a skydiving plane crash in France and a Saudi helicopter crash—have killed 25 people collectively. In the US, wildfires on the Colorado-Utah border have claimed three firefighters. Meanwhile, media crackdowns in Uganda and cross-border strikes between Pakistan and Afghanistan underscore ongoing geopolitical tensions. On a lighter note, the AI-driven chipmaker stock rally continues to dominate markets, and South Korea's early World Cup exit has triggered a coaching resignation and a presidential probe.

- [Venezuela earthquake death toll rises to 1,450](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr47dvywvy5o) — Relatives face another night waiting as the rescue window closes; 33 survivors pulled from rubble.
- [Europe heatwave linked to 1,300 deaths](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cn4d2vv935lo) — Germany hit a record 41.7°C; WHO warns the continent is unprepared.
- [11 killed in French skydiving plane crash](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5yz9yj9x74o) — Pilot and 10 passengers, including five first-time parachutists, died in Tomblaine.
- [Three firefighters die battling Colorado-Utah wildfires](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cp8l7mpmdggo) — Both governors declared states of emergency as multiple blazes rage.
- [Ugandan media outlets shut down by army chief](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj9gyk1z7ngo) — NTV and Daily Monitor offices under military siege; press freedom at risk.
- [South Korea football coach resigns after World Cup exit](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cdx7jk0kq4vo) — President calls for probe; Hong Myung-bo steps down following elimination.
- [Shares in AI chipmakers surge in first half of 2026](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jun/29/shares-in-chipmakers-underpinning-ai-boom-surge-in-first-half-of-2026) — Some manufacturers have tripled in value, driving Asia Pacific markets higher.

**Watch next:** The aftermath of the Venezuela earthquake and European heatwave will continue to unfold, with search and rescue operations and public health responses under scrutiny. Political tensions in East Asia, particularly Japan-South Korea defense cooperation, and the fallout from South Korea's World Cup exit will dominate regional headlines.

military.zh:
过去24小时，全球军事格局急剧震荡：美伊停火协议在签署后迅速破裂，双方互射导弹，伊朗首次攻击巴林与科威特，霍尔木兹海峡紧张局势一触即发；美国同步在冲绳部署陆战队反舰导弹，向中国发出清晰信号；中国南部战区在南海启动例行巡航，并对日本20家实体实施出口管制；乌克兰战场持续胶着，俄承认燃料短缺，美国援乌资金出现逾9亿美元逾期未用。以下是本周刊重点追踪的六大动态。

- **美伊冲突全面升级**：继美国26日打击伊朗导弹与雷达阵地后（[Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/news/your-military/2026/06/26/us-resumes-attacks-on-iran/)），伊朗27日回击霍尔木兹海峡货轮，美国再次空袭（[TWZ](https://www.twz.com/news-features/u-s-carries-out-first-strike-on-iran-since-peace-memorandum-signed)）。28日伊朗更直接攻击巴林与科威特，威胁中止和谈（[PBS](https://news.google.)），海湾14国进入紧急安全警戒（[Travel And Tour World](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE80cFotVURoazBINDNocWxXUGJtdEVrci14MENxbHhQN0NHNjN1Y1JPWEpScFFxUGdXVGZ3Z2xySzVGb2drb05TVjdOYW5xTTUwU05qXzVYaFdWOXVDNjJ5Ml9jeEdyQTU5LUNWNXl3)）。
- **美国在冲绳首次前出部署反舰导弹**：海军陆战队第12濒海团在冲绳部署岸基反舰导弹，这是美军沿第一岛链永久性部署反舰武器的开端（[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/u-s-stations-marine-anti-ship-missiles-in-the-western-pacific/)），分析称此举直指中国（[daily-sun.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxQd3hWUV9kcHY0eE9GS2pwMHVBZ29BeF9pV3ZXVFBUcWNxaEFzZDFuYXAyNG4xc0RhOThHTGIxMWtZbU9Oc3BoQkpnZ2M5Vml3Y240X1h1ckxkalZQYUxjMVNrNnZEMHM4MnllcllOekRIcHA0dXhzTHFhc3lGYjJQcjRBbDBfYlB0dHpqcmxYbVRYX25xUWtQenNVaXJtRGZmV1VydVB1NzBNc3FLWmc4SnZyQ0piWTlWWDB3)）。
- **中国南海巡航与对日反制同步展开**：南部战区组织海空力量在南海例行巡航（[chinanews.com.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE5OLTVYMV85NG5PYlE3MEdjcjNUMHhCTjBqMGdEdnU4ekJJUl9LMW5vaGJtWXktenBWakdfWWswRnZsQUY0cGNRS1VpU01fd21qTDBkZldNNVF6ZE56OEhPeEFMTnBuQkxF)），同时将20家日本实体列入出口管制黑名单，旨在制止日本“再军事化”（[诗华日报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiTEFVX3lxTFBNSmFtNmJST1k5LVpKRVJsOVBpNi1LVFE4M3lBOFVFVEctcG5KS3B6UVQxRmZ6RWhFRHdzQ0JwOWRIQWRKcFFsWXdVaE4)）。
- **乌克兰防空战果与俄方困境**：乌军宣称夜间拦截了2枚“锆石”中的1枚及全部6枚“伊斯坎德尔-M”，但仍有导弹命中目标（[ukranews.com](https://news.google.)）。普京承认乌克兰远程打击造成俄南部燃料短缺（[Dunya News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxNS3gxSGRYYWVUajVCQTQ4S1l1NFJpRnJHZ1VyZ05vdy02Vno0R0RiRk54LUVCWnFYLWVuV1o4bFRzYW4wZXhHaE5GWndzY21NR2VlaGlDTWVMTUh5akRoMkNVRndHSDk2cGtBNWpwdVlOTGEzaHFUZFRURVV6Z0N4WVQ5S3lkbmkxOTJScmk4ZTY2QklINnZZ)）。
- **欧洲安全忧虑加深**：立陶宛民众开始备战俄罗斯（[The Australian](https://news.google.)）；波兰认为俄罗斯可能在波罗的海国家使用“小绿人”混合战术（[Мілітарний](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxPMXlaODZlNWxUUWdZcHBxc25MNWM4dnIwbkY4eHBHSk4zX2tPem1KYWFDbFhJcjc0S3dGWFZHTjJnWVBwcFRlNmhuVFJnYXl1Q2FGeVdWRGZib1o4c2tLX05pb3ZFVm01VDdUTGY3ZnFNT0ZaWExnMVEtd3NzUFhhRVgzR0IwRFFLYnYxY29OdURUelpjNDZwcFV4ZVhqZw)）。
- **军备调整与援助问题**：英国计划以“预算战舰”替换驱逐舰（[Sky News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxOWWFEVXNRU2N4M01JZERCbWQ0RjJ4cmFyZDgzdXFxQWJkZ1pWNUxiY1hGQXJpUURDZzZLWGlJVjB6WmhhbGt3RDBZTmVaLS11ZFVKT0x2N0JZbFN6eGkxZm01ZjRFc1UxemhHN3hHUG9jY3g0NjZ5MFZCNVU0T3pLU3JVVWlTUnN1M2M1enJUdXpxaklp)）；美国国防部被曝有9.1亿美元对乌援助（USAI项目）未按时使用（[Мілітарний](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxNVjFhY2FVWERVbnM2akhraU13TkFwQ0l4R0xEeWJMVFR1eEJtdjQ2aFd4bi1EeTY5eXNPTi1HdnUxLTJWMnpkc3Q5TUV1TXFvLUxFRFBhb3lVVmlzQzc3SnA0RElGS19yckU1d2tFejItUHdzS2dTdHM5TEI2UXRHRi1mVkNNeXJ4WmpxOEp2VTJWQXZhX3NGalFOVjNVZGJUUmNjdXgwdTBBNndq)）。

**后续观察**：美伊冲突已从“影子战争”走向直接对抗，霍尔木兹海峡通行风险急剧升高，国际油价与航运保费或大幅波动。美国在冲绳的反舰导弹部署与中国的出口管制相互叠加，印太军事对峙趋于长期化。乌克兰战场消耗战持续，美国援助效率问题值得关注。
military.en:
The past 24 hours have been marked by a sharp escalation in US-Iran hostilities despite a nominal ceasefire, a significant forward deployment of US anti-ship missiles in Japan, and continued deep-strike operations by Ukraine against Russian fuel infrastructure. China reinforced its South China Sea patrols while imposing export controls on Japanese entities, and a series of European moves—from UK budget warship plans to French shadow fleet seizures—signal shifting defense priorities. These developments underscore a multipolar security landscape where regional flashpoints are increasingly interconnected.

- **US-Iran ceasefire collapses** as both sides trade strikes over the Strait of Hormuz, with Iran hitting Bahrain and Kuwait and the US retaliating against missile and radar sites. The interim peace agreement is under severe threat, and oil markets are reacting [PBS](https://www.pbs.org), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com), [Travel And Tour World](https://www.travelandtourworld.com).
- **US Marines station anti-ship missiles on Okinawa**—the first forward-based American anti-ship weapons along the first island chain—directly challenging China's naval access. This move by the 12th Marine Littoral Regiment signals a new era of precision-strike deterrence in the Western Pacific [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/u-s-stations-marine-anti-ship-missiles-in-the-western-pacific/).
- **Ukraine strikes cause fuel rationing in Russia**, with Putin admitting shortages after a massive drone and missile attack hit refineries across Krasnodar Krai, Belgorod, and other regions. Ukraine also claimed to have downed a Zircon hypersonic missile and six Iskander-Ms [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com), [Dunya News](https://www.news.google.com), [ukranews.com](https://www.ukranews.com).
- **China blacklists 20 Japanese entities** to counter Japan's 'remilitarization' and nuclear ambitions, while the PLA Southern Theater conducted routine patrols in the South China Sea. The US also added Chinese firms to its 'China Military Enterprises' list, drawing a Beijing response [诗华日报](https://www.news.google.com), [chinanews.com.cn](https://www.news.google.com), [财联社](https://www.news.google.com).
- **Pentagon begins work on a 1,600-km air-to-air missile**, a weapon that would radically extend engagement ranges and challenge existing air combat paradigms. The initiative signals a focus on long-range intercept and stand-off capabilities [Defense Express](https://www.news.google.com).
- **France seizes its fifth Russian shadow fleet tanker** in the Mediterranean, continuing a coordinated Western effort to enforce maritime sanctions and disrupt evasion networks [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/26/french-seizes-5th-russian-shadow-fleet-tanker).
- **UK to replace destroyer fleet with 'budget warships'**, a major shift in naval procurement that may trade capability for numbers—a decision that could affect NATO strike group deployments [Sky News](https://www.news.google.com).
- **Lithuania and Poland prepare for potential Russian conflict**: Lithuania's population is wary of the US security guarantee, and Poland warns of 'little green men' tactics in the Baltics, mirroring pre-2014 Ukraine scenarios [The Australian](https://www.news.google.com), [Мілітарний](https://www.news.google.com).

**Watch next:** The US-Iran trajectory will dominate near-term headlines, especially any disruption to Strait of Hormuz shipping. The operational status of the US Marine anti-ship missiles on Okinawa and China's response—be it military posturing or economic countermeasures—will be critical for Indo-Pacific stability. Ukraine's ability to sustain deep-strike campaigns and Russia's fuel crisis may reshape the winter conflict dynamics.

tech.zh:
今日科技新闻呈现两大主线：中国在超算和AI模型上同时取得突破，引发全球关注；而AI行业在狂热中开始反思，福特因AI表现不足重新聘请老工程师，Brown大学爆发大规模AI作弊事件。此外，法拉利首款纯电轿车在中国秒售罄，零排放卡车部署大幅增长，电动化势头不减。HackerNews社区热议年龄验证与言论自由、开源AI模型挑战巨头。

- [中国超算LineShine登顶TOP500](https://www.theverge.com/tech/958768/china-claims-the-worlds-fastest-supercomputer)，无GPU却实现全球最快，打破美国封锁。
- [GLM-5.2在网络安全基准中击败Claude](https://semgrep.dev/blog/2026/we-have-mythos-at-home-glm-52-beats-claude-in-our-cyber-benchmarks/)，中国AI模型在特定领域追上顶尖水平。
- [Ferrari Luce EV中国售罄](https://electrek.co/2026/06/28/controversial-ferrari-luce-ev-is-an-instant-sellout-in-china/)，豪车电动化获市场认可。
- [福特因AI短板重新聘请“灰胡子”工程师](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/28/ford-rehires-gray-beard-engineers-after-ai-falls-short/)，企业开始质疑AI替代人的神话。
- [HackerNews热议：年龄验证是言论自动化归因的前奏](https://nonogra.ph/age-verification-is-just-a-precursor-to-attribution-of-speech-06-29-2026)，社区担忧数字自由被侵蚀。
- [Suno推出Spark计划“喂养”AI音乐模型](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/958801/suno-launches-spark-incubator-program-to-feed-independent-artists-to-its-ai-machine)，艺术与算法的矛盾再次激化。
- [加州7月1日起实施流媒体广告音量限制法](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/28/california-law-targeting-loud-streaming-ads-takes-effect-on-july-1/)，用户体验立法先行。
- [零排放卡车部署2025年增长37%](https://electrek.co/2026/06/28/zero-emission-truck-deployments-surged-up-37-in-2025-as-momentum-builds/)，商用车电动化加速。

**后续观察**：AI领域人才迁移加剧，Google DeepMind六位研究员流失至OpenAI、Anthropic等，同时AI伦理岗位开始雇佣哲学家，行业正在从“能力竞赛”转向“治理竞赛”。中美技术脱钩背景下，中国在超算和AI模型上的独立创新成果值得持续跟踪。
tech.en:
In the past 24 hours, technology news has been dominated by a clash of narratives: China's technological defiance with a record-breaking supercomputer and a competitive AI model, versus Western corporate recalibrations as Ford admits AI fell short and rehires veteran engineers. Meanwhile, the hardware ecosystem saw open-source liberation (Librepods for AirPods) and sobering reminders of AI's limitations in academic integrity and legal proceedings.

- China claimed the world's fastest supercomputer with [LineShine](https://www.theverge.com/tech/958768/china-claims-the-worlds-fastest-supercomputer), built without US GPUs, defying export controls and pushing El Capitan to second place. The feat signals a strategic pivot towards self-reliance in high-performance computing.
- Ford's candid admission that [AI alone failed to deliver quality](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/28/ford-rehires-gray-beard-engineers-after-ai-falls-short/) led to the rehiring of 'gray beard' engineers, underscoring the enduring value of human expertise in complex manufacturing processes.
- The [Ferrari Luce EV](https://electrek.co/2026/06/28/controversial-ferrari-luce-ev-is-an-instant-sellout-in-china/) sold out instantly in China despite pre-launch controversy, proving that brand cachet and EV innovation can override skepticism in the world's largest auto market.
- A Hacker News analysis warned that [age verification laws are a precursor to automated attribution of speech](https://nonogra.ph/age-verification-is-just-a-precursor-to-attribution-of-speech-06-29-2026), sparking a vigorous debate on digital identity and surveillance.
- The open-source project [Librepods](https://github.com/librepods-org/librepods) reached 336 points on Hacker News, offering a liberated firmware for AirPods—a rare hardware jailbreak that empowers users to tweak their devices.
- At Brown University, a professor [denounced mass AI fraud on an exam](https://english.elpais.com/education/2026-06-28/ai-fraud-at-brown-university-academic-integrity-is-at-risk.html), with 457 comments on Hacker News highlighting the growing crisis of academic integrity in the age of LLMs.
- China's Z.ai released [GLM-5.2](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/958804/chinas-z-ai-glm-52-mythos-cybersecurity), which some benchmarks claim matches Anthropic's Mythos in cybersecurity, narrowing the gap between Chinese and Western AI capabilities.
- Major AI players—OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, and Amazon—jointly funded a [$500 million workforce initiative](https://news.google.), signaling a coordinated effort to prepare America's workforce for an AI-driven economy.

**Watch next:** The ripple effects of China's supercomputer breakthrough on US chip export policy, and how the Ford 'gray beard' rehire shapes the debate on AI integration in legacy industries.

sports.zh:
今日体育焦点集中在世界杯淘汰赛的激烈争夺与NBA转会市场的重磅操作上。加拿大凭借补时绝杀首次闯入16强，书写了东道主神话；韩国教练因总统批评和小组出局愤而辞职，凸显亚洲足球的残酷现实。NBA方面，太阳通过交易得到布里奇斯，雷霆高价续约哈滕，尼克斯留住阿尔瓦拉多，各队阵容调整进入白热化。电竞圈MSI入围赛中T1击败KC和TL，但Faker状态遭社区热议。羽毛球世界羽联迎来新主席。以下是详细解读：

- **加拿大补时绝杀创造历史**：东道主加拿大凭借斯蒂芬·欧斯塔基奥在伤停补时第二分钟的进球，2-1击败南非，队史首次赢得世界杯淘汰赛并晋级16强。主帅马什盛赞球员为“加拿大英雄”，这场胜利可能永久改变加拿大足球的版图。[报道](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cvg4pen8xq7o) [视频](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/videos/clyx5432r8do)
- **韩国教练洪明甫辞职**：在韩国总统公开批评和球队早早出局的双重压力下，洪明甫宣布辞职。此前韩国队在小组赛即遭淘汰，国内舆论和政界对其执教表现极为不满。[ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49208667/south-korea-coach-hong-myung-bo-quits-world-cup-exit-criticism-president)
- **莱万接近加盟芝加哥火焰**：据ESPN确认，波兰前锋罗伯特·莱万多夫斯基与MLS芝加哥火焰的转会谈判已进入最后阶段，预计今夏加盟。这是MLS近年最具影响力的签约之一。[ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49211267/chicago-fire-signing-robert-lewandowski)
- **NBA多笔交易与续约**：黄蜂将迈尔斯·布里奇斯和两个选秀权送至太阳，换回格雷森·阿伦、罗伊斯·奥尼尔及一个首轮签；雷霆与以赛亚·哈滕签下3年7500万美元续约合同；尼克斯与何塞·阿尔瓦拉多达成3年1400万以上新约；魔术裁掉乔纳森·艾萨克以节省650万美元；雷霆将以赛亚·乔交易至活塞获得两个次轮签。[布里奇斯交易](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49208142/sources-hornets-trade-veteran-miles-bridges-suns) [哈滕续约](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49193260/thunder-keep-hartenstein-new-3-year-deal-sources-say)
- **MSI入围赛T1双杀欧美战队**：T1在2026季中冠军赛入围赛中先后击败TL和KC，但TL双C出装遭质疑，而Faker的对线表现也被虎扑网友批评“令人不想承认的差”。社区投票显示57.7%的玩家赛前看好KC能战胜T1，结果却遭打脸。[T1 vs KC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE95S1ZkdDRBQUZhZGNqZkVuWXgtZTV6eE5ycXA1ZzZYTGt4X0txLUpEVXFsaVowcWF3a2lRTGZmSloyMEkxRnVFdk41YTJtVDM1V2lSaWZXbXRaZWpvVEgwZHh6cw) [TL争议](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFBJeG9iZVRvWFNTQldDSVp5MnBna1lUOFZEWUVsMWtOYWJkaHYwbENiXzVtSVpsUzJjSDZVdWFOTV9TQVpINDJ6eVFwLS1NbllXQXdyQ2w1YVpzNXI5c1VnOHFVTGNkNHYwVmU3YWVyc0ZNQQ)
- **BWF确认新主席**：Khunying Patama Leeswadtrakul正式当选世界羽联2025-2029年主席，标志着羽毛球管理层的更迭。[BWF](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQVk15S0JXMXh4eFpLMlhsaWd5SnFqeExZZlo4TzJRSVdzOWhnSG52cUV0anpzY1c4Qkc0a1Q3MUtoQUY2OGt0UDhRaEJOb2c1MnlUbUZvSWd4YktuMEYwSTFMNlF4aVRnWHluTFFHWlp4YmFMb29NLTlNWFo5QXpWUnF5dWszRUJhaTFQMzBQRHVKcThud2IwM2FzaVdFYVE)

**后续观察**：世界杯16强对阵即将揭晓，加拿大能否继续“黑马”之旅？巴西与日本一战中久保建英缺阵将如何影响比赛走势？NBA自由市场才刚刚开启，太阳和雷霆的补强后续可能引发更多连锁交易。MSI入围赛T1状态起伏，Faker的竞技水平成为焦点。
sports.en:
The global sports landscape is dominated by two major narratives: the ongoing World Cup knockout stages delivering dramatic upsets and historic firsts, and the NBA offseason heating up with blockbuster trades and free-agent signings. Canada's fairy-tale run as co-hosts continues, while South Korea's coach resigns after early elimination. In the NBA, the Suns and Hornets struck a major deal, and several key players secured new contracts. Meanwhile, the esports community buzzes over T1's MSI performance, and badminton sees leadership transition at the BWF.

- **World Cup Drama**: Canada secured their first-ever knockout win with a dramatic last-minute goal against South Africa, advancing to the round of 16. Coach Jesse Marsch called his players "Canadian heroes" in a moment that could reshape football's future in the country. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cvg4pen8xq7o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49210369/marsch-canadian-heroes-defining-win-south-africa)
- **Coaching Fallout**: South Korea's coach Hong Myung-Bo resigned after heavy criticism from the president following a group-stage exit, highlighting the intense pressure on national team managers. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49208667/south-korea-coach-hong-myung-bo-quits-world-cup-exit-criticism-president)
- **Transfer Buzz**: Robert Lewandowski is close to joining MLS side Chicago Fire, a move that would be one of the biggest in league history. PSG are also finalizing a deal for Yan Diomandé. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49211267/chicago-fire-signing-robert-lewandowski), [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49211932/yan-diomande-close-move-paris-saint-germain)
- **NBA Offseason**: The Suns acquired Miles Bridges from the Hornets in a multi-pick swap, while the Thunder retained Isaiah Hartenstein on a $75M deal. The Magic waived Jonathan Isaac for cap relief. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49208142/sources-hornets-trade-veteran-miles-bridges-suns), [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49193260/thunder-keep-hartenstein-new-3-year-deal-sources-say), [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49200939/orlando-magic-waive-forward-jonathan-isaac)
- **Tennis Injuries**: Emma Raducanu withdrew from Wimbledon due to a leg injury, adding to her string of setbacks. Meanwhile, a retrospective on the golden weekend of British tennis at Wimbledon a decade ago. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/tennis/articles/c15y0q31522o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/tennis/articles/cgev5n0vqv3o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Badminton Leadership**: Khunying Patama Leeswadtrakul has been confirmed as BWF President for 2025-2029, marking a new era for the governing body. [BWF Olympics](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQVk15S0JXMXh4eFpLMlhsaWd5SnFqeExZZlo4TzJRSVdzOWhnSG52cUV0anpzY1c4Qkc0a1Q3MUtoQUY2OGt0UDhRaEJOb2c1MnlUbUZvSWd4YktuMEYwSTFMNlF4aVRnWHluTFFHWlp4YmFMb29NLTlNWFo5QXpWUnF5dWszRUJhaTFQMzBQRHVKcThud2IwM2FzaVdFYVE)

**Watch next**: The World Cup round-of-32 matches including Brazil vs Japan (without Kubo) and Germany vs Paraguay. NBA summer league schedule announced will feature top draft picks. The MSI esports tournament continues with T1's form under scrutiny.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐板块的核心看点是中国影视之夜与白玉兰奖的叠加效应——杨紫首夺白玉兰视后引爆社交媒体，连带引发李现未公开祝贺的争议，甚至导致微博短暂崩溃，折射出顶流粉丝生态的敏感度。海外方面，BET Awards 2026以Lauryn Hill获颁Living Legend Icon及全明星致敬表演掀起高潮，Teyana Taylor与Sylvia Rhone亦获殊荣；John Oliver在密集炮轰特朗普之余，宣布客串《综合医院》与《我们的日子》，娱乐与政治讽刺的边界再度模糊。日韩市场稳中有爆：《Reborn Rookie》收视再创新高，新剧《Flex X Cop 2》定档，i-dle成员助阵《Running Man》预告释出。以下为各子专栏的详细解读与判断。

- [杨紫首夺白玉兰视后，李现未公开祝贺引热议，微博一度崩溃](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxOUHhubHI3SHN6aVNZcEtnVmhlWEwyUjJkVXZCSm9hVERHdUdwTXQ1T0xkaDdWaF9YelV3WFI3VVhXNzdHemFVeDJVUDdfM0tvNG51ZkNLVFlTVDNJczRzOWxrOHh1OVZwd2VqTFlCSUR5WmpaU282dlJGLWsxOTdGbEdfSQ) — 微博社区围绕杨紫封后爆发两极化讨论，李现未在微博祝贺被部分网友质疑“友情是否靠微博证明”，话题迅速发酵；同一时间微博服务器出现故障，官方紧急道歉并修复后“白玉兰热搜第一已消失”，被指有意降温。
- [BET Awards 2026揭晓：Lauryn Hill获Living Legend Icon，Cardi B、Teyana Taylor等获奖并献演](https://deadline.com/2026/06/2026-bet-awards-winners-list-1236969507/) — 颁奖礼上Lauryn Hill获致敬表演（Queen Latifah、SZA、Doja Cat等参与），Sylvia Rhone获Ultimate Icon并强调“算法不能定义我们”；Teyana Taylor在Janet Jackson颁授下泪洒舞台。
- [John Oliver连曝三条重磅：客串《综合医院》与《我们的日子》，炮轰特朗普与Fox News的反映池阴谋论](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/john-oliver-general-hospital-guest-star-1236794160/) — 在《Last Week Tonight》中揭露林肯纪念堂反映池因特朗普翻修沦为“绿色恶臭”池塘，并嘲笑Jesse Watters的虚假报道；同时宣布将分别于7月初在ABC《综合医院》进行三集客串，并在NBC《我们的日子》出演一周。
- [韩剧《Reborn Rookie》收视再创新高，大结局前达11.1%](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850966wpp/reborn-rookie-soars-to-its-highest-ratings-yet-ahead-of-final-week) — 该剧口碑热度双收，能否在最终周突破12%成为悬念；同期《Flex X Cop 2》公开剧本阅读照并定档，Ahn Bo Hyun与Jung Eun Chae组合备受期待。
- [六月明星品牌声誉排行榜：林英雄登顶，i-dle成员Miyeon与Minnie录制《Running Man》预告](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850914wpp/june-star-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-2) — 韩国企业研究所发布月度数据，数据显示Trot歌手维持高热，女团成员活跃度上升。

**后续观察：** 杨紫白玉兰效应预计将在本周持续发酵，李现是否补发祝福、微博如何管理热搜恢复后的话题走向，值得跟进。BET Awards的致敬环节与John Oliver的新闻讽刺进一步放大了好莱坞与政治圈的交织，尤其Oliver的客串决定或可视为脱口秀明星向传统演艺领域渗透的信号。韩剧市场在《Reborn Rookie》收官后，《Flex X Cop 2》与《My Bias, My Boss》等新作将接力竞争，品牌排名则暗示林英雄的长期统治力。
entertainment.en:
Today's entertainment landscape is dominated by major award ceremonies and premiere announcements. The 2026 BET Awards delivered powerful performances and iconic honors, while China's Magnolia Awards and the CMG China Film and Television Night celebrated both established and rising stars. K-drama fans have several new series to anticipate, and social media platforms were abuzz with fan reactions and technical glitches. 

- **BET Awards 2026** saw **Lauryn Hill** honored with the Living Legend Icon Award via an all-star tribute featuring SZA, Doja Cat, Nas, and Queen Latifah. **Cardi B** delivered a fiery performance of 'Am I the Drama?', and **Teyana Taylor** was named Icon of the Year. ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/lauryn-hill-tribute-bet-awards-queen-latifah-sza-doechii-1236798041/), [Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/cardi-b-performs-2026-bet-awards-1235585722/), [Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/teyana-taylor-bet-awards-speech-icon-of-the-year-2026-1235582466/))
- **John Oliver** is making a splash in daytime soaps, guest-starring on *General Hospital* and *Days of Our Lives* while also taking aim at Trump's Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool fiasco. ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/john-oliver-general-hospital-guest-star-1236794160/), [Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/last-week-tonight-john-oliver-reflecting-pool-problems-1236632641/))
- In China, **Yang Zi** won the Magnolia Award for Best Actress, sparking debates about the generational shift in Chinese film and television. **Di Li Reba** was also recognized at the CMG China Film and Television Night. ([新浪新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxOUHhubHI3SHN6aVNZcEtnVmhlWEwyUjJkVXZCSm9hVERHdUdwTXQ1T0xkaDdWaF9YelV3WFI3VVhXNzdHemFVeDJVUDdfM0tvNG51ZkNLVFlTVDNJczRzOWxrOHh1OVZwd2VqTFlCSUR5WmpaU282dlJGLWsxOTdGbEdfSQ))
- K-drama **'Reborn Rookie'** hit a new high of 11.1% ratings ahead of its final week, while **'Flex x Cop 2'** announced its premiere date. **'My Bias, My Boss'** released a teaser showing Kim Hye Joon taking a job to meet her idol. ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850966wpp/reborn-rookie-soars-to-its-highest-ratings-yet-ahead-of-final-week), [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850999wpp/ahn-bo-hyun-and-jung-eun-chaes-flex-x-cop-2-announces-premiere-date), [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850925wpp/watch-kim-hye-joon-gets-a-job-to-meet-her-idol-bias-in-my-bias-my-boss-teaser))
- **Weibo crashed** during the Magnolia Awards ceremony, causing the top trending topic to vanish after restoration. The incident sparked discussions about platform reliability and content moderation. ([搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxOWWo3SWdZX2R4RkZ5cEhJZmNqX0ZHY1FKUi1YQ0pjTC1OZ2JjUGpUamYwYldOVDJnWFU0ZENHSU5uaHowdnJ2RzRtbUF1S1g2dU9mX1VRT0l5a0IwQkVmQ242azNtMHZJTWlLaGplSGl0UjlueHNrS1lkZjYwUWV2bmRqZThBUy0t))
- **Jeremy Clarkson** will return for more *Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?* episodes after being in remission from cancer, a significant personal and professional rebound. ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/global/jeremy-clarkson-who-wants-to-be-a-millionaire-hot-seat-1236791361/))
- The **'Love Island USA' Season 8** cast was revealed, premiering June 2 on Peacock with host Ariana Madix. ([Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lists/love-island-usa-season-8-cast/))

**Watch next:** The fallout from Weibo's crash may continue to trend, while the finale of *Reborn Rookie* and the debut of *Flex x Cop 2* will drive K-drama viewership. John Oliver's soap opera appearances will likely generate cross-platform buzz. Also keep an eye on the ongoing discourse around Yang Zi's Magnolia win as a symbol of China's new generation of actors.

美股.zh:

Goldman Sachs offers optimistic outlook](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1YNEc4dm5jTWh0Snl0N2VhMGp3QzNVS1FCZVhnLUZ6eDJnTFpWOWFQLUZla0ZwOGFLT1dqazBFWDExX0ZiWjE5TzMwLVd3RlFnUUIxdEx3UVVhYkFKdXFlazlYc9IBY0FVX3lxTE1YNEc4dm5jTWh0Snl0N2VhMGp3QzNVS1FCZVhnLUZ6eDJnTFpWOWFQLUZla0ZwOGFLT1dqazBFWDExX0ZiWjE5TzMwLVd3RlFnUUIxdEx3UVVhYkFKdXFlazlYcw)
